intro: 문화학박사이자 축제전문가로, 세종축제·한강몽땅·순천만국제정원박람회 등 대한민국을 대표하는 도시축제와 문화행사를 기획·연출해왔습니다. (사)한국문화기획학교 교장으로서 문화기획 인력 양성에도 힘쓰고 있습니다.
tagline_en: A Cultural Experience Designer Who Shapes Cities Through Festivals
intro_en: A Ph.D. in Cultural Studies and festival specialist, he has planned and directed some of Korea's leading city festivals, including the Sejong Festival, Hangang Mongttang, and the Suncheon Bay International Garden Expo. As Dean of the Korea Cultural Planning School, he is also dedicated to training the next generation of cultural planners.
